Definition: Maazjah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Maaziah was a priest whose name stands in two records of the restored worship. His course was the four and twentieth in David's order of the priests, and his name appears again among the priests who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's day.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Maaziah's course is remembered because God orders His worship by name, and the twenty-fourth course was as holy as the first.
